transcript.content: Hello. I'm glad you're here today. What brings you in to see me?

I'm here because I've been really struggling to cope with a traumatic event that happened nearly two years ago. I keep getting these awful, intrusive memories and flashbacks where it feels like I'm reliving it all over again. I just don't know how to make them stop.
I'm so sorry you've been dealing with that. Do you find yourself actively trying to avoid thoughts, feelings, places, or people that remind you of the event?

Yes, I try constantly to push those thoughts and feelings out of my head. I also completely avoid certain places, people, and conversations because even the smallest reminder brings those awful memories right back.
Have you also noticed feeling constantly on edge, easily startled, or having trouble sleeping since the event happened?

Yes, I feel completely exhausted because I'm constantly tense and jumpy, and if there's a sudden noise or movement, my heart pounds for ages. Sleeping has also been a nightmare; I struggle to fall asleep, wake up constantly from bad dreams, and always wake up feeling totally unrefreshed.
Have you noticed any changes in your mood or the way you think about yourself or others since the event, such as feeling detached or losing interest in things you used to enjoy?

Yes, I've changed a lot and feel completely emotionally numb, as if my mind is empty and all positive feelings are blocked. I can't seem to feel happiness or satisfaction even when good things happen. I also feel incredibly detached and unable to feel love or affection for my family anymore.
